verdict.rationale: First-party docs clearly describe the unattended long-job part of the story: after a brief scoping exchange, Marlin runs on its own for up to roughly eight hours and delivers a report and slides. Nothing in the pack shows it notifies the user when the result is ready (no email, push, or webhook alert). missing for 10: completion notification mechanism, independent or hands-on corroboration of unattended runs.

support.subject: As an analyst, I can start a long research job that keeps working unattended and notifies me when the result is ready

citations.quote: Give it a research topic, and Marlin works autonomously for up to roughly eight hours, crafting a detailed strategy report up to a hundred pages long, along with executive summary slides.
Once the course is set, it works without further human input
Sakana Marlin scales up inference-time compute to execute up to eight hours of continuous, autonomous reasoning.
Marlin carries the research through to completion and delivers both summary slides and a detailed report.
